tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// tshogs gsum rin chen las byung ba'i// byang chub them skas 'dir bsten na// bla med yang dag khang bzang rtser// bde blag 'god byed 'di na gsal//

oṃ swa sti/ chos kun mnyam nyid dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du// 'gyur med rang shar bde chen sgyu 'phrul gar// ma 'gag rol rtsed snang stong sprul pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal pos byang chub bar du skyongs// ko sha'i mtshor 'khrungs sangs rgyas padma skyes// lhar bcas gtsug gi nor bus mchod 'os pa// 'phur 'gro'i slob dpon gang khyod tshe rabs phreng*// bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du rtag par rol// rgyal rnams phrin las skabs gsum tshangs ral gyi// rgyun bzang nges don ring lugs ma dros bdag /bstan 'dzin gdengs can bdag po karma ka /mi shigs snying gi thig le'i dbus su bsti// rgyud sde bzhir 'brel yi dam lha rab 'byams// rig 'dzin dpa' po ḍā ki la sogs pa// ye shes spyan ldan mgon rnams dus kun tu// 'bral med bsnyen no mchog thun grub gnyis stsol// mngon spyod phrin las rol pas khro bo'i tshul// ma hā kā la dam can chos srung ma// ye shes las dang 'jig rten dregs byed rnams// thugs dam rjes dgongs phyi nang bar chad sol// de ltar mchog gsum rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bla med bsngags 'os rnams la gus btud nas// mchod brjod mā li ka yi phreng ba yis// mdun bsus bdag blo dwangs pa'i yid mtsho ru// lhag bsam zla zer 'od snang spro bzhin du// kho bor bong ba gser mthong dad zhes can// kun gyis gya nom dngos por bstab pa rnams// snying po med la snying po len pa'i phyir// dkon mchog mchod pa'i bsod nams zhing sa ru// dmigs nas 'bul gyi bzhes pa'i dge gang des// dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje can rnams kyi// zag med thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*// rgyal bstan snying por gyur pa gang de dag /nyams med yun gnas de 'dzin skyes bu rnams// 'tsho gzhes phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab// 'dus pa'i sde tshogs bslab gsum sdom gnas shing*// bdag dang bdag la 'brel gyur ji snyed pa// mkha' khyab pha ma'i rang bzhin de snyed rnams// mngon mtho nges legs go 'phang thob pa'i slad// byang phyogs kha ba can gyi yul ljongs 'dir// rgyal bas lung bstan zla 'od gzhon nu zhes// bstan 'dzin rgyu skar dbus su ri bong 'dzin// gang de'i ring lugs sgrub brgyud 'chang ba che// mnyam med dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bstan pa'i srol// karma kaṃ tshang nyi zla ltar grags pa// theg mchog nges don bla med snying po yi// bstan pa mi nub gong nas gong 'phel zhing*// nyams med yun du gnas par bya ba'i phyir// si tu'i ming gis brjid pa'i 'du gsum pa// padma nyin byed dbang por grags de yis// dpal chen sdom pa'i sa spyod gsung gi gnas// bka' brgyud rje btsun gong ma'i skyes rabs phreng*// grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi gdan sa che// 'og min karma'i gtsug lag khang bzang nas// rab byung bcu gsum drag po lcags sprel lo// bskal bzang bzhi pa'i dus chen gsum 'dzoms pa'i// sa zla'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba dang po nas// spel ba'i dngos rdzas bdog pa kun bsdoms pa// tsi na'i ljon 'dab 'khor drug chig stong dang*// sum brgyas mtshon pa de dag chos kyi sde// so so'i 'du khang rnying gso gsar bzhengs dang*// rten gsum snang brnyan la sogs ji snyed pa// khyad par rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor cho ga dang*// gzungs sngags chos skyong dus gtor la sogs pa// kha bskang bgyid dang dkyil 'khor gsar 'dzugs dang*// rgyal rnams dgyes bskyed spyan gzigs mchod pa'i rdzas// sna tshogs bkod pa las grub ngo mtshar phyir// bstar ba'i bye brag dngos po'i rnam grangs ni// 'dir spel de ltar legs byas rmad byung che// brtan par rgyun bzhag dge rtsa 'dzad med pa// ji srid bar du chos kyi 'khor lo'i gzhi// legs par grub 'di'ang kho bo'i gtan 'dun gyi// blo gtad ma nor bstan la bya ba grub// de yang thog mar gdan sa bar ma karma dgon chen gyi rten gtso/

byams chen drung du/ dkar bum che legs cha/ gser me gnyis/ sbub chol bzang gras cha gcig /spyan snga rta shod par gos dmar gyi ber/ thub chen drung rgyan bzhi'i bla bre che ba gcig /sbub chol rnying ma cha gcig /gser me gnyis/ dkar bum ljang khra gnyis/ sngo khra gcig /karma pa rabs bcu gsum drung*/ sku brnyan gsum la rgya gar gos chen skyen khab ber/ yang bzang gos dmar skya 'brug ris can gyi ber/ yang bzang gos ser po spos rgya 'brug ris can gyi ber bcas/ rje bdud 'dul rdo rje'i 'dra zhal sman sku gser chab can gsar bzhengs tor gos 'brug brgya ma'i ber bcas/ snyan shal nyi shu skor/ sbub chol 'bring cha gcig /gser me gnyis/ mkhar kong mtshan thub brgya rtsa brgyad/ thub dbang dngul sku nyams gsos dang ling chen shin legs kyi snam sbyar/ gong ma na rim bzhi'i sku brnyan la gos dmar sku ber re/ khro bo lha khang du/ gu ru rin po cher gos dmar sku ber/ gter chen sku 'drar ling chen shin legs kyi snam sbyar/ 'cham chas la/ gos ya shi nag po'i 'cham ber bzang gos dmar po dang ser po'i sked khra can nyer gnyis/ ral gri bzhi bcu/ bhandha bzhi bcu/ ḍā ru bcu drug /phur pa bzhi bcu/ tshes bcu dgu gtor gyi zhi ba dang khro bo'i zhal 'bag ma ral bcas chas 'dzoms bzhi bcu/ 'bag sgam che legs gcig /gser rnga bcu/ dung dkar gcig /zhwa chung bcu gnyis/ zhwa khra gsum/ rgyal mtshan shin du che legs gcig /'phan bco brgyad/ yang rgya 'phan padma can che chung bcu drug dbu gdugs dar sham can/ phyar dar dkar po gnyis/ zhwa nag bcu gsum/ stag lpags gcig /me sbor gnyis/ ral gri gnyis/ rag ting thog bdun 'og bdun/ rag gi chu skyes che legs cha/ li ting bdun tshar/ kun dga' ra ba gsar bzo che ba mchod stegs bcas/ snyan shal nyi shu skor/ li ting bdun tshar/ dril chen bzhi/ spom brag lha khang la gser 'phru spus ldan/

mgon khang du snyan shal nyi shu skor/ ral gri 'gu zi gcig /ral gri mo rkang gcig /me sbar sog bog chu ris can khyad mtshar/ gzig /g.yi/ wa/ spyang bcas kyi pags pa re/ ༈ karma lha steng du/ rten gtso jo bo'i drung*/ hor gos kyi snam sbyar/ 1 rgya gar gos can skyen khab kyi bla bre/ 1 ting bdun cha/ 1 snyan shal bcu skor/ rgya 'phen padma can/ mgon khang du/ snyan shal/ gzig lpags/ 1 spyang lpags/ 1 ral gri/ 3 me spor/ 2 rten bzhag sbub chol rnying ma 'brug ris can spus legs/ 1 ༈ lha thog mdzod dgon la/ rgya sbub rnying ma che legs/ 1 rgya sil rnying ma che legs cha/ 2 hor gos dmar po gser 'brug can gyi 'cham gos spus legs/ bzang gos 'jam dmar po 'brug gor can le'u hor jus la bzos pa'i snam sbyar spus legs/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gos khrab cha 'grigs gser rmog dang 'phru bcas/ phye 'phur/ 2 rgyal mtshan/ 1 'phan/ 2 rgya 'phan padma can/ phyar dar dkar po/ 2 dar phra/ 2 rag ting thog bdun 'og bdun che legs/ stag lpags/ 1 rgya gling cha/ ༈ zur mang bdud rtsi dil la/ 'phan ring cha/ 1 rgyal mtshan cha/ 1 rgya 'phan padma can che chung cha/ 2 ting bdun rgya nag mchu ris can che legs/ ༈ go che gnas mdo dgon la/ grwa sbub che legs cha gnyis/ dngul gyi maṇḍal/ 1 ḍā ru/ 15 rgyal mtshan/ 2 rgya 'phan padma can che chung*/ 2 dar dkar/ 2 phyag dar/ ༈ gnas mdo bde chen dgon la 'khar rnga shin tu spus ldan che legs/ 1 sbub chen 'brug ma shin tu che legs/ 1 ༈ skyo brag dgon la/ rgyal mtshan/ 2 'phan/ 2 rgyan bzhi ser khra'i bla bre che/ 1 zhwa khra/ 32 chos gos/ 2 sbub chol rgya gsar che/ 1 rag ting thog bdun 'og bdun/ 'cham gos/ 17 ral gri/ 14 rgya gling cha/ 1 ༈ ja pa dgon zhabs la/ zam su'i 'cham gos/ 17 ral gri/ 14 rgya gling cha/ rag dung cha/ 1 rag gi kong bu brgya rtsa/ mgon khang du snyan shal/ gzig /spyang*/ wa bcas kyi pags pa re/ me sbor/ 11 ral gri/ 2 ༈ skyabs che dgon la/

mdzad bcu'i zhal thang khyad mtshar can bcu gsum la rgyan bzhi'i gong gsham/ thub dbang gser sku gser zangs can rnying ma/ 4 li sku/ 28 mkhar sku che chung*/ 26 sman bla gser sku/ 1 sgrol ma'i gser sku/ 2 zangs sku/ 1 rag sku/ 2 mkhar sku/ 1 spyan ras gzigs mkhar sku che chung*/ 5 rag sku rgyab yol can/ 1 karma pakshi'i sku rnying ma byin chen/ 1 rang byung rdo rje'i gser sku/ 1 yang karma pa gser sku/ 1 mkhar sku/ 1 li sku/ 1 o rgyan mkhar sku chung*/ 2 byams pa zangs sku/ 1 rag sku/ 1 rdor sems rag sku rgyab yol can/ 1 don yod grub pa mkhar sku/ 1 'jam dbyangs mkhar sku/ 1 lab sgron mkhar sku/ 1 dzaṃ ser mkhar sku/ 1 gser sku/ 1 'byung 'dul mkhar sku/ 1 phyag rdor mkhar sku/ 1 gur mgon rag sku/ 1 khyon sku 'dra re bzhi/ zangs gser bka' gdams mchod rten che chung*/ 3 mkhar li'i mchod rten/ 2 dri gtsang khang du/ ras khra'i gnam rgyan/ gser me bzhi/ dkar yol ne tso/ 2 dkar yol seng ge cha/ rag ting thog bdun 'og bdun/ dung dkar/ 1 sbub chol gsar pa/ 1 zhi dkar chu skyes cha/ 1 mgon khang du spyan gzigs la/ snyan shal mdzod dar/ 8 sog po'i me sbor rnying ma/ 2 ral gri 'gu zi se bo/ gzig /g.yi/ spyang*/ wa bcas kyi pags pa re/ yang ral gri/ 1 me sbor/ 2 g.yas g.yon cha/ 3 khrab chen spus legs cha/ 2 lha khang du/ rgyal mtshan/ 2 'phan/ 2 yang 'phan/ 2 bla bre/ 1 zhwa khra/ 27 chos gos/ 1 snyan shal mdzod dar/ 2 sbub chol rgya nag ma che legs/ gos gser 'brug can gyi yol ba/ dkyil 'khor sgab skor cha tshang*/ gser rnga/ 19 li ting che legs dngul srang*/ 12 00 ri ba/ dung dkar steng gshog can cha/ ༈ skyabs che'i sgrub khang la/ zhal thang gos chen gong gsham ldan pa/ 10 li'i maṇḍal/ ting bdun/ sbub chol/ rnga chung*/ mkhar rnga bcas/ ḍār chen/ ༈ gnas mdo bzo rig dgon la/ gos chen gnam yol rnying pa/ 1 ras khra'i gnam rgyan/ 2 mgon khang du snyan shal/ 3 sog bog dzam grags spus legs/

1 yang me sbor/ 1 ral gri/ 2 ༈ 'dzi sgar la/ rgyal mtshan/ 2 'phan/ 2 yang 'phan/ 2 snyan shal mdzod dar bcu skor/ ༈ drung ram sgar la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas snang brnyan gser zhal can gsar bzhengs/ snam sbyar ling chen las grub pa/ snyan shal bar ling kha dog lnga/ gos chen gnam rgyan/ 1 rgyal mtshan/ 1 ka 'phan/ 8 yang 'phan cha/ bla bre kha bab/ nye sras zhal thang bzang gos gong gsham can gsum/ ༈ dpal 'byor dgon la/ snyan shal/ 5 sog po'i me sbor spus legs gnyis/ rgya yi me sbor khyad mtshar/ 1 ral gri gnyis/ ༈ zhe 'dzong dgon la/ mdzad bcu'i zhal thang gos chen gong gsham can/ 13 dung dkar gshog ldan cha gcig /'phan cha/ 1 nye sras gtso 'khor dang zhwa dmar nag bcas kyi zhal thang che legs bzang gos cod ldan gong gsham bkra ma can spus ldan bcu gnyis bcas/ ༈ slar yang 'phags tshogs dge 'dun sde rnams la/ dang ba bskyed cing bsod nams spel ba'i phyir// gangs can lha gcig 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// bod kyi lha skal nyid du zhal 'ches bzhin// karma ka dang rnam dbyer med ces pa// thub dbang rgyal bas bsngags pa'i gnas gyur na// so skye'i tshogs rnams sgo gsum cis mi 'dud// des na lha dang bla ma tha mi dad// dgongs pa ro gcig don dam chos nyid ngor// rang sems skye med spros bral chos kyi sku// rang byung lhan skyes gdod ma'i sangs rgyas dngos// ye nas yin bzhin snang grags chos thams cad// 'dzin med gsal stong snying rje zung 'jug gis// rgyas gdab ngang nas gsung mchog yi ge drug /bskul phyir 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyin byed kyi// gdan sa dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor lo'i// yang dben sgrub brgyud dar rgyas gling nyid nas/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa yi nang tshan gyi// rnam byung zhes pa sa pho 'brug gi lo// bdag cag ston pa rnam 'dren shāka thub kyi// dus chen gsum 'dzoms sa ga zla ba yi// dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po nas brtsams te// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir du// dge rtsa spel 'di bod yul dbus 'gyur 'chang*// lha ldan gandho la sogs gsang gsum gyi// rten drung mchod 'bul 'og min mtshur phu nas// li yul lcang ra smug po'i bar dag gi

/chos grwa'i 'dus sde'i tshogs rnams che long dang*// dngos po'i tho grangs 'dir ni bkod par spro// de yang thog mar dzam gling byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs bod yul sa yi thig le skye dgu'i skyabs gnas mchod yul du mngon par grub pa'i lha ldan gandho la chen po'i rten gtso jo shāka rin po rnam gnyis kyis mtshon lha rten rnams dang*/ bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dang*/ g.yu ru sprul pa'i khra 'brug la sogs bod ljongs phyogs kyi gsang gsum snang brnyan tshar du dngar ba rnams kyi drung du snyan shal mdzod dar/ 27 mchod 'bul rten dngul srang*/ 50 00 sgrub brgyud kaṃ tshang rin po che'i gdan sa thugs kyi gnas mchog 'og min dpal gyi mtshur phur lha chen thub dbang dzam gling rgyan dang*/ rje gong ma na rim gyi chos sku'i rten mchog sogs kyi drung du/ snyan shal mdzod dar/ 10 mchod 'bul rten du dngul/ 71 00 'dus sder phyag 'gyed dngul/ 15 00 bde chen yangs pa can byams chen gtsos lha rten drung*/ snyan shal mdzod dar/ 5 mchod 'bul dngul/ 8 00 gnas nang rgyal ba'i ri khrod rten gsum drung snyan shal/ 4 mchod 'bul rten dngul/ 80 0 gnas nang sngags grwa bcas 'dus sder phyag 'gyed rten dngul/ 7 00 'brug ra lung dang gsang gling mthong smon sogs kyi rten gsum drung snyan shal mdzod dar/ 20 00 mchod 'bul rten dngul/ 10 00 skyabs gnas kun 'dus rigs brgya'i khyab bdag 'brug pa rin po che mchog gi drung du dge rtsa byang chen gyi rgyur bsngo ba'i rgyas gdab zhu rten dngul/ 50 00 'dus sder phyag 'gyed dngul/ 20 00 yongs 'dzin rin po cher dngul/ 14 00 zur mang gar dbang rin po cher dngul/ 31 00 ri bo che stag lung chos grwar lha rten drung snyan shal/ 10 mchod 'bul dngul/ 10 00 mang ja rten dngul/ 4 00 ༈ de nas dngul dkar 'gyed 'bul tho la/
